		var:zg361_case_w_state = scope:zg361_pp_subject_prompt_state
		var:zg361_case_w_state = 5
		var:zg361_case_w_active = 1
		NOT = { has_variable = zg361_pp_m190_subject_response }
	}
	option = {

zg361pp.2146 = {
	type = character_event
	hidden = yes
	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:zg361_pp_m146_audit_1_owner = var:zg361_case_t_owner
				var:zg361_pp_m146_audit_1_subject = this
				var:zg361_pp_m146_audit_1_cycle = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				var:zg361_pp_m146_audit_1_case = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial
				var:zg361_pp_m146_audit_1_expected_state = var:zg361_pp_m146_receipt_state
				var:zg361_pp_m146_audit_1_expected_state = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m146_audit_1_state = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m146_audit_1_consumed = 0
				var:zg361_pp_m146_receipt_active = 1
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_audit_1_consumed value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_audit_1_state value = 2 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_audit_revision add = 1 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m146_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_audit_1_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m146_delivery_style } }
			if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_m146_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_audit_1_outcome value = 1 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_m146_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_audit_1_outcome value = 2 } }
			else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_audit_1_outcome value = 3 } }

			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m146_route = 3 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_audit_1_business_input value = var:zg361_pp_m146_frozen_grade }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_audit_1_business_settled value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_visible_outcome_code value = var:zg361_pp_m146_route }
			}
			else = {
				# Route C closes only its policy-debt timer; it cannot manufacture
				# the typed business field named above.
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_audit_1_policy_debt_settled value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m146_visible_outcome_code value = 3 }
			}
			change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_visible_receipt_revision add = 1 }
		}
		else = { debug_log = "ZG361PP: stale 146 audit ticket ignored" }
	}
}

			}
			else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_appeal_closed_without_filing value = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m151_route = 3 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m151_audit_2_business_input value = var:zg361_pp_m151_grade_at_delivery }

	hidden = yes
	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:zg361_pp_m161_audit_1_owner = var:zg361_case_u_owner
				var:zg361_pp_m161_audit_1_subject = this
				var:zg361_pp_m161_audit_1_cycle = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				var:zg361_pp_m161_audit_1_case = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial
				var:zg361_pp_m161_audit_1_expected_state = var:zg361_pp_m161_receipt_state
				var:zg361_pp_m161_audit_1_expected_state = 3
				var:zg361_pp_m161_audit_1_state = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m161_audit_1_consumed = 0
				var:zg361_pp_m161_receipt_active = 1
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m161_audit_1_consumed value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m161_audit_1_state value = 2 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m161_audit_revision add = 1 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m161_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m161_audit_1_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m161_sham_competition } }
			if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_m161_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m161_audit_1_outcome value = 1 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_m161_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m161_audit_1_outcome value = 2 } }
			else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m161_audit_1_outcome value = 3 } }

			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m161_route = 3 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m161_audit_1_business_input value = var:zg361_pp_m161_filler }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m161_audit_1_business_settled value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m161_visible_outcome_code value = var:zg361_pp_m161_route }
			}
			else = {
				# Route C closes only its policy-debt timer; it cannot manufacture
				# the typed business field named above.
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m161_audit_1_policy_debt_settled value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m161_visible_outcome_code value = 3 }
			}
			change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_visible_receipt_revision add = 1 }
		}
		else = { debug_log = "ZG361PP: stale 161 audit ticket ignored" }
	}
}

			}

			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_audit_1_state value = 2 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_audit_revision add = 1 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m185_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_audit_1_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m185_pip_midpoint } }
			if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_m185_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_audit_1_outcome value = 1 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_m185_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_audit_1_outcome value = 2 } }
			else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_audit_1_outcome value = 3 } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m185_route = 3 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_midpoint_pending value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_midpoint_completed value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_progress_snapshot value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_progress_truth_status value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_progress_red_code value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_resource_delivery_valid value = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:zg361_b2_pip_owner = var:zg361_case_w_owner
						var:zg361_b2_pip_subject = this
						var:zg361_b2_pip_cycle = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial

						var:zg361_b2_pip_support_hours = 12
					}
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_resource_delivery_valid value = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_pp_m185_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_midpoint_status value = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_pp_m185_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_midpoint_status value = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_late_correction_invalid value = 1 }
				}
			}
			zg361_pp_w_try_advance_02_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m185_route = 3 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_audit_1_business_input value = var:zg361_pp_m185_midpoint_status }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_audit_1_business_settled value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_visible_outcome_code value = var:zg361_pp_m185_route }
			}
			else = {
				# Route C closes only its policy-debt timer; it cannot manufacture
				# the typed business field named above.
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_audit_1_policy_debt_settled value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m185_visible_outcome_code value = 3 }
			}
			change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_visible_receipt_revision add = 1 }
		}
		else = { debug_log = "ZG361PP: stale 185 audit ticket ignored" }
	}

zg361pp.2188 = {
	type = character_event
	hidden = yes
	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_owner = var:zg361_case_w_owner
				var:zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_subject = this
				var:zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_cycle = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				var:zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_case = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial
				var:zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_expected_state = var:zg361_pp_m188_receipt_state
				var:zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_expected_state = 4
				var:zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_state = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_consumed = 0
				var:zg361_pp_m188_receipt_active = 1
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_consumed value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_state value = 2 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_audit_revision add = 1 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m188_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m188_relapse_window } }
			if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_m188_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_outcome value = 1 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_m188_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_outcome value = 2 } }
			else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_outcome value = 3 } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m188_route = 3 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_observation_pending value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_observation_closed value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_same_category_relapse value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_relapse_status value = 2 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_result_case_owner
						has_variable = zg361_result_cycle_serial
						has_variable = zg361_result_case_serial
						has_variable = zg361_result_case_state
						has_variable = zg361_result_grade
						has_variable = zg361_result_grade_reason
						var:zg361_result_case_owner = var:zg361_case_w_owner
						var:zg361_result_cycle_serial = var:zg361_pp_m188_observation_due_cycle
						var:zg361_result_case_state >= 3
						var:zg361_result_grade = 1
					}
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_observed_result_owner value = var:zg361_result_case_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_observed_result_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_observed_result_cycle value = var:zg361_result_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_observed_result_case value = var:zg361_result_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_observed_result_state value = var:zg361_result_case_state }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_observed_result_grade value = var:zg361_result_grade }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_observed_result_reason value = var:zg361_result_grade_reason }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_observed_category value = 1 }
					if = { limit = { var:zg361_result_grade_reason = 5 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_observed_category value = 3 } }
					if = {
						limit = {
							OR = {
								var:zg361_pp_m188_route = 2
								AND = { var:zg361_pp_m188_route = 1 var:zg361_pp_m188_observed_category = var:zg361_pp_m188_category_snapshot }
							}
						}
						if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_m188_observed_category = var:zg361_pp_m188_category_snapshot } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_same_category_relapse value = 1 } }
						set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_relapse_status value = 1 }
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_pp_m188_relapse_status = 2 }
				zg361_pp_m189_skip_no_relapse_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_case_w_owner = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 3 }
				if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m188_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m188_route = 3 } var:zg361_case_w_owner = { has_trait = arbitrary } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 2 } }
				zg361_pp_m189_core_effect = {
					ROUTE = var:zg361_pp_ai_route
					TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_w_owner
					TICKET_SUBJECT = this
					TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
					TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial
					TICKET_STATE = 4
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_case_w_owner = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
				save_scope_as = zg361_pp_prompt_subject
				var:zg361_case_w_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_pp_prompt_owner }
				save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
				save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_case value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
				save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_state value = 4 }
				save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_mechanism value = 189 }
				var:zg361_case_w_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.189 days = 1 } }
			}
			# The stage timeout may already have consumed #189 as route C while
			# this delayed #188 audit was pending.  Recheck the barrier after the
			# audit closes so that exact fallback cannot strand W in state four.
			zg361_pp_w_try_advance_04_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m188_route = 3 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_business_input value = var:zg361_pp_m188_relapse_status }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_business_settled value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_visible_outcome_code value = var:zg361_pp_m188_route }
			}
			else = {
				# Route C closes only its policy-debt timer; it cannot manufacture
				# the typed business field named above.
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_audit_1_policy_debt_settled value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m188_visible_outcome_code value = 3 }
			}
			change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_visible_receipt_revision add = 1 }
		}
		else = { debug_log = "ZG361PP: stale 188 audit ticket ignored" }
	}
}

			else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_audit_1_outcome value = 3 } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m190_route = 3 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_audit_delivery_acl_pass value = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:zg361_pp_m190_receiving_manager = var:zg361_pp_m190_acl_receiver
						var:zg361_pp_m190_receiving_manager = {
							var:zg361_pp_received_transfer_disclosure_bundle = root.var:zg361_pp_m190_disclosure_bundle_id
							var:zg361_pp_received_transfer_disclosure_subject = root
							var:zg361_pp_received_transfer_disclosure_cycle = root.var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
							var:zg361_pp_received_transfer_disclosure_case = root.var:zg361_case_w_case_serial
							var:zg361_pp_received_transfer_disclosure_vacancy = root.var:zg361_pp_m190_vacancy_id_snapshot
							var:zg361_pp_received_transfer_goal = root.var:zg361_pp_m190_goal_snapshot
							var:zg361_pp_received_transfer_support = root.var:zg361_pp_m190_support_snapshot
							var:zg361_pp_received_transfer_completion = root.var:zg361_pp_m190_completion_snapshot
							var:zg361_pp_received_transfer_subject_statement = root.var:zg361_pp_m190_subject_statement_snapshot
						}
						var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_status = 2
						var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_active = 1
						var:zg361_transfer_request_pp_owner = root.var:zg361_case_w_owner
						var:zg361_transfer_request_pp_subject = root
						var:zg361_transfer_request_pp_cycle = root.var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
						var:zg361_transfer_request_pp_case = root.var:zg361_case_w_case_serial
						var:zg361_transfer_request_vacancy = root.var:zg361_pp_m190_vacancy_id_snapshot
					}
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_audit_delivery_acl_pass value = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_pp_m190_audit_delivery_acl_pass = 1 }
				zg361_career_hc_settle_pp_transfer_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_audit_external_status value = var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_status }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_audit_external_red_code value = var:zg361_transfer_adapter_red_code }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m190_route = 3 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_audit_1_business_input value = var:zg361_pp_m190_audit_delivery_acl_pass }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_audit_1_business_settled value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_visible_outcome_code value = var:zg361_pp_m190_route }
			}
			else = {
				# Route C closes only its policy-debt timer; it cannot manufacture
				# the typed business field named above.
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_audit_1_policy_debt_settled value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m190_visible_outcome_code value = 3 }
			}
			change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_visible_receipt_revision add = 1 }
		}
		else = { debug_log = "ZG361PP: stale 190 audit ticket ignored" }
	}
}

zg361pp.2191 = {
	type = character_event
	hidden = yes
	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_owner = var:zg361_case_w_owner
				var:zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_subject = this
				var:zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_cycle = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				var:zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_case = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial
				var:zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_expected_state = var:zg361_pp_m191_receipt_state
				var:zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_expected_state = 5
				var:zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_state = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_consumed = 0
				var:zg361_pp_m191_receipt_active = 1
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_consumed value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_state value = 2 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_audit_revision add = 1 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m191_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m191_exit_cost_statement } }
			if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_m191_route = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_outcome value = 1 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_m191_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_outcome value = 2 } }
			else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_outcome value = 3 } }

			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m191_route = 3 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_business_input value = var:zg361_pp_m191_net_cost }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_business_settled value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_visible_outcome_code value = var:zg361_pp_m191_route }
			}
			else = {
				# Route C closes only its policy-debt timer; it cannot manufacture
				# the typed business field named above.
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_audit_1_policy_debt_settled value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m191_visible_outcome_code value = 3 }
			}
			change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_visible_receipt_revision add = 1 }
		}
		else = { debug_log = "ZG361PP: stale 191 audit ticket ignored" }
	}
}
